basics.name: Jayleen Jiang
basics.label: Mathematics undergraduate
basics.summary: Mathematics undergraduate at Mount Holyoke College interested in applied probability, scientific computing, dynamical systems, and optimization.

work.name: University of California, Los Angeles / IPAM RIPS
work.position: Researcher, Cross-Spectral Image Correspondence for Industrial Robot Perception
highlights: Formulated visible-infrared image correspondence for factory robot perception.
Developed evaluation protocols for thermal hotspots, low texture, specular surfaces, and repeated structures.
Explored descriptor confidence, geometric consistency, and abstention criteria for safer matching.

work.name: UMass Amherst
work.position: Undergraduate Researcher, Numerical Study of Energy Cascades in Nonlinear Schrödinger Systems
highlights: Built a high-throughput SIMD Monte Carlo integrator for stochastic NLS energy-cascade chains.
Studied long-chain nonequilibrium steady states and anomalous sub-diffusive heat transport.
Developed mesh-free neural-network Fokker-Planck and eigenfunction solvers.

work.name: University of California, Berkeley
work.position: Researcher, Fairness-Constrained Optimization for EV Charger Placement
highlights: Formulated EV charger deployment as a multi-objective network optimization problem.
Integrated demographic and infrastructure-derived demand forecasts.
Built scalable heuristics using candidate-site reduction, greedy construction, and local improvement.

work.name: Mount Holyoke College
work.position: Undergraduate Researcher, Computational Neural Mechanisms of Distal Speech Rate Effects
highlights: Developed a semi-Markov particle-filter model with rate-dependent duration priors.
Connected computational predictions with ERP findings for speech-rate-dependent word segmentation.

work.name: Mount Holyoke College
work.summary: Courses: Calculus I-III, Intermediate Statistics, Mathematical Statistics, Real Analysis.
highlights: Supported students in problem solving, proof structure, and quantitative reasoning.
